individual-data-points.explanation: Stacked composition chart showing median state frequencies per bin (fractions summing to 100%); like a pie/area composition plot, individual promoter values cannot be meaningfully overlaid.
Single-molecule raster plot where every row represents one individual DNA molecule, so individual data points are inherently displayed alongside the aggregate state-frequency sidebar.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The middle line of the box represents the median. The box displays the interquartile range (IQR), 25th to 75th percentile. Whiskers represent a distance of 1.5 x IQR.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (median line, IQR box, 1.5xIQR whiskers) are explicitly defined in the caption.
